display.purpose: Hero headlines only. The 48px-112px fluid range fills the visual field at large viewports, like a journal cover.

headline.purpose: Section titles (h2). Reads like a chapter heading in a medical reference.

title.purpose: Card headings, modal titles, feature names (h3).

body.purpose: All running prose. 16px minimum, 1.55 line-height, 65-75ch max line length.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows, metadata, pricing tier names, data values. IBM Plex Mono signals system precision.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Hero and featured containers only. Reads as slight lift off parchment.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused form inputs and interactive elements. Teal halo.

shadows.name: modal-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Modal overlay. No blur. Solid enough to push background content to background.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Color, border, opacity transitions on interactive states. The minimum perceptible response time.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: The 1px translateY(-1px) on button hover and the 2px card lift on hover.

motion.name: entrance-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven section entrance (translateY 18px to 0). Only fires when prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: active-press
motion.purpose: scale(0.97) on btn:active. Immediate tactile compression.

breakpoints.name: mobile-nav
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: hamburger nav, hide nav links.

breakpoints.name: mobile-form
breakpoints.purpose: Login page: below this, hide visual pane, single column.

breakpoints.name: features-2col
breakpoints.purpose: Feature grid switches from 1 to 2 columns.

breakpoints.name: features-3col
breakpoints.purpose: Feature grid switches from 2 to 3 columns.

breakpoints.name: pricing-3col
breakpoints.purpose: Pricing plan grid switches from 1 to 3 columns.

breakpoints.name: hero-2col
breakpoints.purpose: Hero section switches from stacked to side-by-side.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action. Ink-filled pill. Reserved for the most important single action on screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #161a1d; color: #f6f5f1; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid oklch(54% 0.09 195); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with border. Never competes with primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: transparent; color: #161a1d; border: 1px solid rgba(30,35,39,0.08); border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #3c4246; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 0.1s; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid oklch(54% 0.09 195); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Evidence Teal action. One per screen maximum. Use for the single most confirmation-adjacent action.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; background: oklch(54% 0.09 195); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { opacity: 0.88; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 0.1s; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid oklch(54% 0.09 195); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Focus state is the most visible Evidence Teal application in the product.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #595f64; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(30,35,39,0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #161a1d; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #595f64; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3c4246; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(54% 0.09 195) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard elevated surface for content grouping. White on parchment creates the lift.
components.html:
01

Diagnóstico diferencial

Diferenciales ordenados por probabilidad, con la evidencia que los respalda.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(30,35,39,0.08); border-radius: 14px; padding: 28px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #3c4246; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #595f64; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #161a1d; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; color: #3c4246; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky top nav with blur backdrop. The brand mark is the only logo element. Nav links are minimal.
components.html:
MediQ
ChatPreciosMi cuenta
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; backdrop-filter: saturate(1.1) blur(10px); background: color-mix(in oklab, #f6f5f1 82%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(30,35,39,0.05); } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 clamp(20px, 4vw, 56px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #161a1d; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: #161a1d; position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-brand-mark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(54% 0.09 195); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #3c4246; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: #161a1d; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid oklch(54% 0.09 195); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Section identifier. IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, with a leading hairline. Marks structural hierarchy, never decorative.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #595f64; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 18px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Inline semantic badge for plan tier, trial status, or confirmation state. Color derived from semantic token at 10-15% opacity.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge--ok { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(60% 0.12 155) 12%, transparent); color: oklch(40% 0.12 155); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(60% 0.12 155) 25%, transparent); } .ds-badge--teal { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(54% 0.09 195) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(40% 0.09 195); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(54% 0.09 195) 25%, transparent); } .ds-badge--warn { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(62% 0.14 40) 12%, transparent); color: oklch(42% 0.14 40); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(62% 0.14 40) 25%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
MediQ's visual system is the typeset equivalent of a well-maintained clinical notebook: warm off-white pages, near-black ink with precise hierarchy, and a single muted teal marking what requires attention. Every design decision is filtered through the question a consultant asks before opening their mouth: 'Is this necessary?' If the answer is no, it doesn't appear.

The system is editorial without being decorative. Fraunces (variable optical-size serif) carries the structural weight of headings, reinforcing that MediQ reasons and presents, never sells. Inter handles the body work quietly; IBM Plex Mono serves labels, metadata, and anything that must feel accurate rather than conversational.

Color is restrained to near-monochrome with one accent: Evidence Teal, a muted cyan-green that appears where clinical attention is warranted. In dark mode, the accent shifts from teal (hue 195) to green (hue 155) — terminal energy replacing daytime precision. This is intentional and should never be corrected.
keyCharacteristics: Three-typeface hierarchy: Fraunces (serif display) + Inter (sans body) + IBM Plex Mono (label/code)
Near-monochrome palette with one restrained accent (Evidence Teal)
Flat-by-default elevation; depth through tonal layering, not shadows
Warm off-white base (#f6f5f1), not white; ink near-black (#161a1d), not black
Dense information layout with intentional breathing room at section breaks
All semantic colors expressed in OKLCH for perceptual linearity

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Evidence Teal appears on no more than 10% of any given screen surface area. Its restraint is what makes it legible as 'action' or 'confirmation'.

rules.name: The Hue-Shift Rule
rules.body: Dark mode shifts Evidence Teal from hue 195 (teal) to hue 155 (green) at higher lightness. This is intentional. Never override --accent in dark mode back to hue 195.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: The page is #f6f5f1, not #fff. Cards are #fff specifically because the contrast with the parchment base communicates elevation.

rules.name: The Italic Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis in Fraunces headings uses font-style: italic; font-weight: 300, not bold. Bold on Fraunces at display sizes reads loud and unmedical.

rules.name: The Mono Precision Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono never appears in running body copy. It marks system metadata, labels, and data — a fact, not a sentence.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The ambient card shadow appears only on hero/featured containers. Regular cards use border-only separation. A new shadow must earn its place.

dos: Do use oklch() for all semantic colors (accent, ok, danger, warn, info). Hex is reserved for neutral surfaces.
Do use Fraunces at font-weight 400 with letter-spacing: -0.02em for all display and headline sizes.
Do express em-tag emphasis inside Fraunces headings as font-style: italic; font-weight: 300.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for all metadata labels at 10.5-12px with text-transform: uppercase and letter-spacing: 0.08-0.12em.
Do keep Evidence Teal below 10% of any given screen surface area.
Do confirm that all interactive elements have :focus-visible with the 2.5px Evidence Teal outline before shipping.
Do use prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference guards for all decorative animations.
donts: Don't use purple, violet, or blue-purple anywhere. MediQ is not a SaaS productivity tool for knowledge workers.
Don't use hospital blue (#0078D4, #1890FF) or white-dominant clinical layouts with stethoscope/heart iconography.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). Use a single solid color.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent on cards, callouts, or alerts.
Don't use AI-hype aesthetics: neon on dark, particle effects, animated gradient backgrounds, ChatGPT/Midjourney palette.
Don't use consumer-wellness softness: pastel palettes, rounded-everything layouts, Calm/Headspace-adjacent softness.
Don't add nested cards. A card inside a card collapses the elevation system.
Don't add glassmorphism as decoration. The top navigation blur is the only sanctioned use.
Don't use #000000 or #ffffff as the base page or body text color.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left, margin, padding). Animate only transform and opacity.
